Katharina Hobgarski (born 18 June 1997) is a German tennis player. So far, she has won 17 singles titles and 18 doubles titles on the ITF Circuit . On 9 January 2023, she reached her best singles ranking of world No. 189. On 29 July 2024, she peaked at No. 244 in the WTA doubles rankings. In May 2016, Hobgarski was awarded a wildcard for the main draw of the Nuremberg Cup .
